summary: Results‑oriented technology leader with 18+ years of IT experience, including 8 years of supervisory roles. Proven ability to develop and execute IT strategy, build high‑performing teams, and deliver cost‑saving initiatives that enhance business processes and revenue.

experience.title: VP of Information Technology
responsibilities: Transformed the IT department and developed an IT strategy to increase sales and improve business process efficiency.
Built and managed a high‑performing team of employees, vendors, and service providers.
Oversaw IT budgeting, vendor negotiations, and business intelligence reporting.
Managed task delegation, staff mentoring, and performance reviews.

experience.title: VP of Information and Security Technology
responsibilities: Led all IT operations, including purchasing, budgeting, and organizational structure.
Conducted performance reviews and prepared reports for the CEO and VP of Sales.
Trained employees on system use, workflow procedures, and technology policies.
Managed external vendors and consultants, and served as HIPAA compliance officer.
Aligned new product concepts with corporate technology and strategic goals.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Managed information security to meet HIPAA compliance guidelines.
Advised executives on advanced technology solutions and participated in the Executive Management Team.
Established a lean IT department to respond quickly to support requests.
Designed and developed a new Electronic Data Processing system using Visual Studio 2010, SQL Server, and ASP.NET.
Oversaw all infrastructure areas.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Improved and expanded the Commissions Tracking Application and integrated it with the CRM.
Increased system uptime from 80% to over 99% by implementing Hyper‑V virtual servers and DFS.
Developed and deployed corporate software and mobile apps for employees.

experience.title: Application Developer
responsibilities: Designed, built, and implemented an ETL commission database system using SQL databases and ASP.NET.
Provided data analysis and reporting that recovered over $2.5M in lost commissions.
Provided end‑user desktop support.

experience.title: Electronics Technician
responsibilities: Deployed and maintained CAT5 and fiber optic cable installations.
Trained subordinate technicians and conducted performance reviews.
Installed Windows NT on more than 400 computers.

projects.name: Enterprise Phone System Implementation
projects.description: Implemented a new phone system that saved the company over $100,000 annually and eliminated out‑of‑pocket expenses through vendor contract negotiation.

projects.name: Video Conferencing Deployment
projects.description: Enhanced nationwide office communications using video conferencing, saving over $50,000 annually in travel costs.

projects.name: CRM Integration
projects.description: Integrated the company’s CRM with marketing systems to provide real‑time feedback to marketing and end users.

projects.name: Hyper‑V Migration
projects.description: Converted VMWare to Hyper‑V, reducing recovery time and lowering costs as part of the Disaster Recovery Plan.

projects.name: Disaster Recovery Plan

projects.name: Automated Quoting System
